Here’s how I’d like to see the ABC:

X: 1
T: Paddy On The Landfill
M: 4/4
L: 1/8
R: reel
K: Gdor
G,A,B,D G4 | AGFD GE | F2 AF BFAF | BAGF GFDF |
G2 BG AGBG | F2 AF BFAF | BAGF DFGA | BcAB G4 :|
g2 dg fgdg | /g/g/g dg fdcA | g2 dg fgdg | gabg agfd |
g2 dg fgdg | /g/g/g dg fdcA | BAGF DFGA | BcAB G4 :|

First, bar lines aren’t needed at the beginning of lines. Second, spaces to show the division of beats and give a little breathing room around bar lines. Third, eliminate the space between GE in the second measure so they beam correctly. Fourth, it seems to be in G dorian, so one flat in the key signature and no = needed for the lone E.

↳ Posted by pfiddle@gmail.com on January 24th, 2010.

Triplets

Muspc, /g/g/g in bars 10 and 13 is not valid abc. Dividers (/) go after, not before notes. So it’s either g/g/g (two 1/16 + one 1/8) or (3ggg (triplet, as in the original).
The second part should start with a left repeat |:. The only place where this is obsolete is the very beginning of a tune.

↳ Posted by Jürgen on January 31st, 2010.

Yes,

I was just adjusting DJF’s ABCs. Should have noticed the extra / and the missing reapeat. Thanks for pointing those things out, Jurgen! (Although, repeats at the beginning of parts are often left out and the extra slash doesn’t affect conversion in a program like concertina.net)
